006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010
011/**
012 * FOFD: Exceptions related to errors in formatting date/time values.
013 *
014 * @see <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#formatting-dates">
015 *      XPath Functions 3.1 - Formatting Dates and Times</a>
016 */
017public class FormatDateTimeFunctionException
018    extends FunctionMetapathError {
019  @NonNull
020  private static final String PREFIX = "FOFD";
021  /**
022   * <a href=
023   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOFD1340">err:FOFD1340</a>:
024   * Raised when the picture string supplied to a date/time formatting function
025   * does not conform to the required syntax.
026   */
027  public static final int INVALID_PICTURE_STRING = 1340;
028  /**
029   * <a href=
030   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFOFD1350">err:FOFD1350</a>:
031   * Raised when a component specifier within a picture string refers to a
032   * component that is not available in the value being formatted.
033   */
034  public static final int COMPONENT_NOT_AVAILABLE = 1350;
035
036  /**
037   * the serial version UID.
038   */
039  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
040
041  /**
042   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
043   * and no cause.
044   *
045   * @param code
046   *          the error code value
047   * @param message
048   *          the exception message
049   */
050  public FormatDateTimeFunctionException(int code, String message) {
051    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
056   * and {@code cause}.
057   *
058   * @param code
059   *          the error code value
060   * @param message
061   *          the exception message
062   * @param cause
063   *          the original exception cause
064   */
065  public FormatDateTimeFunctionException(int code, String message, Throwable cause) {
066    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
071   * the {@code cause}.
072   *
073   * @param code
074   *          the error code value
075   * @param cause
076   *          the original exception cause
077   */
078  public FormatDateTimeFunctionException(int code, Throwable cause) {
079    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), cause);
080  }
081}
